reason: The hypothesis directly restates the approach and findings of P10, P13, P18, P22, P24, and P27, which already explored reducing Ta (and Hf) content in Hf-Nb-Ta-Ti-Zr alloys to lower density while maintaining strength, and even achieved a specific low-density composition (Hf0.25NbTa0.25TiZr) with similar mechanical properties. The proposed substitution of Ta with Nb in HfMoTaTiZr is a trivial extension of this established strategy, with no new mechanism or integration of disparate sources.
copied_elements: Partially substitute heavy Ta with lighter Nb in HfMoTaTiZr to lower density
Nb has lower atomic mass than Ta, reducing average atomic weight and density
Ta and Nb are chemically similar and mutually soluble, retaining BCC solid solution
Density reduction of ~10-15% while maintaining comparable strength
Simultaneous reduction of Hf and Ta to lower density while maintaining strength (P10, P13, P18, P22, P24, P27)
